body:
# Anti Nausea Texture Pack

Anti Nausea is a lightweight Minecraft texture pack that removes or reduces the nausea visual effect for a cleaner and more comfortable gameplay experience. The default nausea effect in Minecraft can cause heavy screen distortion, making gameplay difficult or uncomfortable for many players. This texture pack helps improve visibility while keeping the game smooth and close to vanilla.

Designed for survival, PvP, SMP, and general gameplay, Anti Nausea provides a simple quality-of-life improvement without affecting performance or changing the overall Minecraft aesthetic.

## Features

* Removes or reduces nausea screen distortion
* Cleaner and smoother gameplay experience
* Better visibility during gameplay
* Lightweight and performance friendly
* Vanilla-style appearance
* Easy to install and use
* Compatible with modern Minecraft versions

Perfect for players who want a more comfortable Minecraft experience without annoying screen effects.
